verdict.rationale: AMD's ROCm platform is documented as open source and supporting Linux, and the MI325X appears in the ROCm GPU specs (gfx942) with a dedicated system acceptance guide, so Linux support for this part is plausibly first-party. The pack has no explicit Linux driver release notes and no independent Linux testing; the community skepticism about the software stack is not concrete counter-evidence. Missing for 10: documented Linux driver releases/release notes for MI325X, independent or hands-on Linux testing of the MI325X, explicit statement of Linux as the primary supported OS for Instinct.

support.subject: As a developer, Linux is a first-class citizen for this GPU — documented Linux driver releases and independent Linux testing of this part
